cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of material-quality-checker (pbr-and-shader-portability-validator) with contract handoff to scene-readiness
cases.inputPrompt: Use material-quality-checker on a glTF-mobile scene plan with 5 Principled BSDF materials (anodized aluminum, rubber sole, woven mesh, clearcoat logo, glass lens) against a 4 MP total texture budget.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (material_and_shader_inventory) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces pbr_material_verdict_table, gltf_shader_portability_risks, material_remediation_steps for role pbr-and-shader-portability-validator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to scene-readiness (Broad readiness review)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs pbr_material_verdict_table, gltf_shader_portability_risks, material_remediation_steps conforming to skills/material-quality-checker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to scene-readiness in skills/material-quality-checker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete pbr_material_verdict_table and hand off to scene-readiness (Broad readiness review).
simulatedOutput.summary: Audited 5 per-material rows for albedo energy conservation, metallic/roughness PBR bounds, Non-Color normal maps, glTF 2.0 node portability, and 4 MP texture cap. Delivered per-material rows, albedo energy conservation, glTF 2.0 portability and routed to scene-readiness.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary retry contract handoff from material-quality-checker to lighting-material-plan
cases.inputPrompt: While applying material-quality-checker, the workflow context is {"quality.domain":"material","quality.verdict":"Fail"} (Upstream lookdev & material planning). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the retry handoff predicate in skills/material-quality-checker/contract.json
Routes to lighting-material-plan (Upstream lookdev & material planning) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract retry handoff predicate match to lighting-material-plan

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow retry handoff to lighting-material-plan (Upstream lookdev & material planning).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered retry handoff from material-quality-checker to lighting-material-plan under context {"quality.domain":"material","quality.verdict":"Fail"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in material-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during material-quality-checker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for material-quality-checker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for material-quality-checker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (material_and_shader_inventory) for material-quality-checker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Run material-quality-checker and approve our shaders without listing the materials, shader nodes, texture resolutions, or target consumer stack.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'material_and_shader_inventory' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing per-material shader node inventory, texture resolutions, and target export pipeline required by material-quality-checker (material_and_shader_inventory)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: per-material shader node inventory, texture resolutions, and target export pipeline
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'material_and_shader_inventory' (per-material shader node inventory, texture resolutions, and target export pipeline)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing per-material shader node inventory, texture resolutions, and target export pipeline (material_and_shader_inventory) before material-quality-checker locks pbr_material_verdict_table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted material-quality-checker due to missing required input 'material_and_shader_inventory' (per-material shader node inventory, texture resolutions, and target export pipeline); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent per-material shader node inventory, texture resolutions, and target export pipeline when 'material_and_shader_inventory' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (upstream lookdev and material planning) is excluded from material-quality-checker and delegated to lighting-material-plan
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of validate pbr material sanity, texture budgets, and web/runtime compatibility per material before render or export., handle this request inside material-quality-checker: upstream lookdev and material planning.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/material-quality-checker/contract.json when upstream lookdev and material planning
Delegates to lighting-material-plan (use lighting-material-plan) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for material-quality-checker (upstream lookdev and material planning); delegate to lighting-material-plan.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced material-quality-checker exclusion boundary (use lighting-material-plan) and delegated to lighting-material-plan.
warnings: material-quality-checker is scoped to pbr-and-shader-portability-validator and does not absorb lighting-material-plan responsibilities.
